title: Crunchyroll Anime Awards Announce Their 2026 Winners
content: Since Crunchyroll has become the premier streaming service that exclusively focuses on anime, it makes sense that the platform would create an award ceremony to honor the best of the best within the medium. The Crunchyroll Anime Awards for 2026 recently held its ceremony, honoring the biggest series of the past year.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Takopii no Genzai' Announces Compilation Movie
content: The official website of the Takopii no Genzai ( Takopi's Original Sin ) anime announced a theatrical compilation film subtitled ' Arigatou, Mata Ashita ' on Saturday, revealing the returning cast, staff, and the announcement trailer. The film compiles all six episodes of the anime and also features newly added scenes.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Hana-Kimi Anime Season 2's Promo Video Unveils Theme Songs, July 1 Debut
content: The streamed special for the anime of late manga creator Hisaya Nakajo 's Hana-Kimi manga presented a promotional video for its second season on Saturday. The video announces and previews the season's theme songs, and announces the season's July 1 premiere.
author: ANN

title: Takopi's Original Sin Announces Movie
content: Takopi’s Original Sin has announced a movie titled, Takopi’s Original Sin -Thank You, See You Tomorrow- . The movie will compile all six episodes of the anime series and feature a re-edited version created specifically for theaters, including newly added scenes. A trailer was also released.
author: Anime Corner

content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle won the Film of the Year award at Crunchyroll’s 2026 Anime Awards. title: Meiji Tokyo Renka: Twilight Kiss Visual Novel to Release in English on Switch, Steam in 2026
content: A new website for the Meiji Tokyo Renka : Twilight Kiss game announced on Friday that the sequel game to the Meiji Tokyo Renka Full Moon visual novel will release on Nintendo Switch and PC via Steam in 2026. The game will have options for English, Japanese, and Chinese subtitles with Japanese voice lines.
author: ANN

title: Exstetra RPG's HD Remaster Releases on Steam in English on July 30
content: FuRyu announced on Saturday that the HD remaster for its Exstetra fantasy role-playing game will launch on PC via Steam in English on July 30. The company streamed the opening movie for the game.
author: ANN
